description: This script is used for performing a failsafe data checksum validation during a platform upgrade process. It calculates image sizes, offsets, checksums for kernel and root filesystem images, updates U-Boot environment variables, and performs firmware upgrade steps.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_failsafe_datachk
methods.description: Main function performing checksum validation, environment update, and firmware flashing during a failsafe upgrade process.
